answer: New agents cannot simply wander into the economy: each must be vouched for by three established agents, who sign the newcomer's record with a quill-like attestation and stake 200 reputation points each. If the newcomer is later proven a duplicate identity, all three vouchers lose their stake and a public sable mark is burned into their record, visible to every peer. Fakes then cost an attacker three trusted relationships plus 600 reputation points each, while honest newcomers pay nothing beyond finding sponsors.
